title: MPP metered session on Tempo (open, vouchers, top-up, cooperative close)
summary: For streaming and per-unit pricing. The client opens an escrow channel with a deposit, then pays with off-chain cumulative vouchers sent to the same URI; the server settles when it likes and closes cooperatively, capturing only what was spent.
specVersion: draft-tempo-session-00 (v2 text merged 2026-06-25, repository text of 2026-10-05 at commit 50309c8)

steps.label: 402 with intent="session"
steps.detail: The amount is the price per unit; the request names unitType, suggestedDeposit, recipient and methodDetails.escrowContract, chainId and sessionProtocol. For v2 the escrowContract names the TIP-20 channel escrow precompile (or a compatible deployment); mpp.dev lists the precompile at the same address on mainnet (4217) and Moderato (42431).

steps.label: action open
steps.detail: The client signs a transaction that deposits into the escrow and an initial voucher of 0, and sends them with the channelId (and the v2 descriptor).

steps.label: Broadcast open
steps.detail: The server broadcasts the open transaction, adding a fee payer signature if it offered one, and verifies the channel.

steps.label: 200, stream begins, receipt
steps.detail: Every paid response carries a receipt with channelId, acceptedCumulative and spent.

steps.label: action voucher (HEAD allowed)
steps.detail: As units are consumed the client signs EIP-712 vouchers with a rising cumulativeAmount and sends them, with the v2 descriptor, to the same URI. Vouchers are off-chain and cost no fee.

payload.content:
# decoded credential payload (Illustrative example, spec version draft-tempo-session-00)
{ "action": "voucher", "channelId": "0x6d0f...8e9f", "descriptor": { "...": "..." }, "cumulativeAmount": "250000", "signature": "0x1234...cdef" }

steps.label: action topUp when low
steps.detail: When the deposit runs low the client sends a topUp credential to the same URI: a signed transaction with channelId, the v2 descriptor and additionalDeposit. It needs a challenge; outside a live stream the client can get one with a HEAD request.

payload.content:
# decoded credential payload (Illustrative example, spec version draft-tempo-session-00)
{ "action": "topUp", "type": "transaction", "channelId": "0x6d0f...8e9f", "descriptor": { "...": "..." }, "transaction": "0x76f901...", "additionalDeposit": "5000000" }

failures.condition: The challenge id is unknown or expired

steps.label: Broadcast topUp
steps.detail: The server checks that the transaction calls topUp with that additionalDeposit, adds a fee payer signature if it offered one, and broadcasts it; the new deposit is usable at once. A top-up also cancels any pending close request.

steps.label: settle (optional, any time)
steps.detail: The server may claim the difference between the newest voucher and what is already settled, periodically or by threshold.

steps.label: action close
steps.detail: The client asks to close with a final voucher.

steps.label: close
steps.detail: The server captures max(spent, settled on chain), never more than delivered service, and the rest returns to the payer. If the server never closes, the client uses requestClose and, after at least 15 minutes, withdraw.

failures.outcome: Forced close: requestClose, grace period of at least 15 minutes, withdraw.

steps.label: 200 with Payment-Receipt (close txHash)
steps.detail: The response to the close request carries a receipt with the close transaction hash. A streamed response also ends with a payment-receipt event that carries the final acceptedCumulative and spent.

payload.content:
# decoded Payment-Receipt of the close response (Illustrative example, spec version draft-tempo-session-00)
{ "method": "tempo", "intent": "session", "status": "success", "timestamp": "2026-10-11T12:10:00Z",
  "reference": "0x6d0f...8e9f", "challengeId": "kM9xPqWvT2nJrHsY4aDfEb", "channelId": "0x6d0f...8e9f",
  "acceptedCumulative": "250000", "spent": "250000", "txHash": "0x1a2b...7890" }
